name: Regeneration Mist · Death · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 6.52-block radius for 15 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 6.52 blocks with 39% health
• Puts out fire
• Blindness for 3 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
